sponsored.t: Relates to notice of applications for major capital improvement rent increases
sponsored.sum: Requires notice of applications for major capital improvement rent increases to include a statement on the first page explaining in plain language the tenant's right to answer or reply and how a tenant may request an extension of time to submit such answer or reply.

sponsored.t: Includes the attacks on September 11, 2001 in courses of instruction in patriotism and citizenship
sponsored.sum: Includes the attacks on September 11, 2001 in courses of instruction in patriotism and citizenship.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing, directly or indirectly; prohibits the collection, use, retention, or sharing of data to facilitate surveillance pricing; provides exceptions; provides for enforcement by the attorney general; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires the testing of baby food and infant formula for toxic heavy metals and the disclosure of such test results
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Baby Food and Infant Formula Safety and Transparency Act"; requires the testing of baby food and infant formula for toxic heavy metals and the disclosure of such test results.

sponsored.t: Requires property/casualty insurance companies to submit certain data to the department of financial services and authorizes premium discounts to policyholders who demonstrate certain mitigation actions
sponsored.sum: Requires property/casualty insurance companies to submit certain zip code-level data to the department of financial services on nonrenewal rates, nonpayment cancellation rates, other cancellation rates, claim frequency rates, average claim amounts, paid loss ratios, and average premiums; requires property/casualty insurance companies that use a natural disaster risk model or scoring method to assign risk, information about such model or scoring method; authorizes a premium discount to policyholders of homeowners insurance or property/casualty insurance applicable to residential real property who demonstrate certain mitigation actions; requires insurers to post about such discounts on their…

sponsored.t: Requires the registration of data brokers and establishing a data deletion mechanism for consumers
sponsored.sum: Requires the registration of data brokers; imposes regulations upon data brokers; establishes a data deletion mechanism for consumers; imposes penalties upon data brokers for violations of the law.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain financial institutions from charging a fee based on the frequency of payments or for changing the frequency of mortgage payments
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain financial institutions from charging a fee for making monthly, semi-monthly, and biweekly payments or for changing the frequency of mortgage payments.

sponsored.t: Enacts the stop highway community harm act
sponsored.sum: Prevents an increase in vehicular lane capacity of highways within two hundred feet of certain public housing facilities, in areas with high rates of asthma, and in environmental justice communities.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing additional duties of the community gardens task force
sponsored.sum: Requires the community gardens task force to conduct an assessment of all community gardens located on publicly owned land in the state to facilitate each garden's designation as a critical environmental area.

sponsored.t: Requires entities that access a consumer's consumer credit report to notify such consumer of their right to obtain a security freeze
sponsored.sum: Requires entities that access a consumer's consumer credit report to notify such consumer of their right to obtain a security freeze, in addition to other information necessary to place, temporarily lift or permanently lift such security freeze; prohibits notices to consumers of their right to obtain a security freeze from containing advertising for paid services.

sponsored.t: Prohibits online retailers from basing prices on certain criteria
sponsored.sum: Prohibits online retailers from basing reference prices on the hardware, software, or geolocation of an online device.

sponsored.t: Prohibits payment card networks from assessing penalties against small businesses or financial intermediaries who fail to comply with the credit card surcharge notice requirement
sponsored.sum: Prohibits payment card networks from assessing penalties against small businesses or financial intermediaries who fail to comply with the credit card surcharge notice requirement; declares any clause of a contract, agreement, or arrangement in violation of such provision void.

sponsored.t: Requires an annual report on the New York state college choice tuition savings program and the translation of vital documents in the most common non-English languages
sponsored.sum: Requires an annual report on the New York state college choice tuition savings program to be delivered to the governor and the legislature and posted on the comptroller's website and the translation of vital documents in the most common non-English languages.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "New York junk fee prevention act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "New York junk fee prevention act"; requires clear and conspicuous pricing practices regarding junk fees.

sponsored.t: Enacts the consumer camera privacy act
sponsored.sum: Prohibits manufacturers or operators of networked camera devices to enable coordinated surveillance features on such devices as a default feature without first obtaining affirmative opt-in consent from the owner; requires disclosure of data rights for owners of such devices; prohibits coordinated surveillance features to be disclosed to law enforcement without a warrant; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires property/casualty insurance companies to submit information on multifamily housing premiums and claims paid to the department of financial services
sponsored.sum: Requires property/casualty insurance companies to submit information on multifamily housing premiums and claims paid to the department of financial services.

sponsored.t: Requires advertisements of a discounted price of a good or service have such price be actually discounted from a bona fide regular price
sponsored.sum: Requires advertisements of a discounted price of a good or service have such price be actually discounted from a bona fide regular price.

sponsored.t: Prohibits algorithmic wage-setting
sponsored.sum: Prohibits algorithmic wage-setting; provides for exceptions; provides for penalties for violation; creates a private right of action.

sponsored.t: Enacts the preventing algorithmic pricing discrimination act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the preventing algorithmic pricing discrimination act; requires the disclosure of algorithmically set prices.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Artificial Intelligence Literacy Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Artificial Intelligence Literacy Act which establishes an artificial intelligence literacy in the digital equity competitive grant program.

sponsored.t: Requires any student graduating from a high school in New York state be provided with a voter registration form
sponsored.sum: Requires any student graduating from a high school in New York state be provided with a voter registration form.

sponsored.t: Prohibits transportation network companies from enacting surge pricing during declared federal, state and local emergencies
sponsored.sum: Prohibits transportation network companies from enacting surge pricing during declared federal, state and local emergencies; subjects violators to a two hundred fifty dollar fine.

sponsored.t: Increases transparency in ticket reselling marketplaces
sponsored.sum: Increases transparency in ticket reselling marketplaces by requiring ticket resellers have accounts which show their name and a photo of them.

sponsored.t: Relates to owner liability for failure of operators to comply with toll collection regulations; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to owner liability for failure of operators to comply with toll collection regulations; requires public authorities to send a notice to owners upon incurring an obligation to pay a toll; provides for the adjudication of such liability and defenses to an allegation of liability; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of labor to prepare an annual report on the cost of living, poverty rates and adequacy of the current minimum wage in the state
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of labor to prepare an annual report on the cost of living, poverty rates and adequacy of the current minimum wage in the state.

sponsored.t: Creates an affordable housing insurance relief fund program
sponsored.sum: Creates an affordable housing insurance relief fund program to provide grants to eligible projects for reasonable and necessary commercial insurance expenses.

sponsored.t: Relates to domestic violence training for judges, court clerks and law enforcement officers
sponsored.sum: Requires judges or justices in a court that exercises criminal jurisdiction, including town and village justices, family court judges, and justices of the supreme court who regularly handle matrimonial matters, and court clerks of such courts to attend a program approved by the chief administrator of the courts addressing issues relating to domestic violence totaling at least ten hours every two years; requires law enforcement officers to complete ten hours of domestic violence training every two years.

sponsored.t: Enacts the End Bullying and Discrimination in Schools Everywhere (BEACON) Act
sponsored.sum: Strengthens protections against discrimination, harassment, and bullying based on actual or perceived immigration status, and to improve implementation and oversight under the Dignity for All Students Act.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the chair of the state liquor authority to make certain quarterly reports
sponsored.sum: Requires the chair of the state liquor authority to make quarterly reports to the governor and the legislature of the authority's enforcement activities for the preceding quarter.

sponsored.t: Relates to the provision of patient health information and medical records
sponsored.sum: Relates to the provision of patient health information and medical records; expands the definition of medical records to include all health related records; prohibits fees for providing certain records.

sponsored.t: Establishes the insurance and housing task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes the insurance and housing task force to ensure the availability of affordable housing and affordable housing insurance.

sponsored.t: Relates to terms and conditions of employment for members of certain collective negotiating units; appropriates funds
sponsored.sum: Provides for the adjustment of stipends of certain incumbents in the state university of New York and designating moneys therefor; continues a doctoral program recruitment and retention enhancement fund; continues work-life services and pre-tax programs; continues a professional development committee; continues a comprehensive college graduate program recruitment and retention fund; continues a fee mitigation fund; continues a downstate location fund; continues a joint labor management advisory board; continues an accidental death benefit; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Requires the New York state thruway authority to submit biannual reports to the legislature of all fiscal transactions, receipts and expenditures
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York state thruway authority to submit biannual reports to the legislature of all fiscal transactions, receipts and expenditures, with each report covering activity from the prior six months.

sponsored.t: Relates to breast cancer screening and diagnostic testing for incarcerated individuals in accordance with certain nationally recognized clinical practice guidelines
sponsored.sum: Provides incarcerated individuals with access to breast cancer screening and diagnostic testing in accordance with certain nationally recognized clinical practice guidelines.
